failure.root_cause: The first runner draft used one shared used-number set for both the legacy and corrected portfolios. Once their first-line choices differed, the legacy second/third lines were constructed against the corrected portfolio's used set, so the legacy comparator was not a valid independently disjoint portfolio.

repair.legacy_portfolio_disjointness: maintain its own used-number set across all three roles
repair.corrected_portfolio_disjointness: maintain its own used-number set across all three roles
repair.candidate_pool_interpretation: The candidate-pool ranking rule is unchanged. Later available candidate-pool contents may differ as a downstream consequence of earlier line selections; those differences are recorded, not misclassified as a changed ranking rule.
